snippet.title: v8.7 Passage to New Dawns Trailer — Honkai Impact 3rd
snippet.description:
v8.7 Passage to New Dawns is coming soon! Raiden Mei's new S-rank battlesuit Xentinel · Dawnbearing Crescent debuts!
Main Story Part 2 Chapter XI Interlude: The Night Which the Light Dreams Of, featured event "Timely: An Eve's Miracle✲", and new outfits are coming! Stay tuned!
Voice Artists:
Senadina: Suzuki Minori
Rice Cake: Rie Kugimiya
Raiden Mei: Miyuki Sawashiro
